text: Alex ruled (2026-11-10): the repo may inventory STYLE LoRAs we use, but NOT the people/actor/character/adult-content LoRAs — 'we can inventory the style loras we use, not the people, actor or character or adult-content loras we use'. Also: the dialogue inside the prompts is a derivative work, so prompt say-lines stay; the raw source transcripts (subtitle rips, dialogue-timeline, ASR) do not ship.

FNI REPO MADE PUBLIC (2026-11-10). Six paths purged from all history: audio/Fire.and.Ice.1983.1080-en.srt, script/fire-and-ice-1983.srt, script/dialogue-timeline.tsv, audio/asr_segments.jsonl, docs/missingvidtranscript.txt (third-party YouTube narration), scratch_objinfo.json (~40 LoRA filenames incl. adult ones, was reachable by SHA). Person/actor LoRA inventory tokenised: subhuman_sweep.py's 25-name celebrity map + 3 RLY-thot_shot LoRAs in the plate graphs' PowerLoraLoader nodes + sweep manifests/browser data now reference person_NN; real map in gitignored runs/actor_loras.local.json, tool loads it at runtime; token form is person_NN because person-27 broke Python identifiers (4 files, caught by py_compile). All tailnet/LAN IPs replaced with placeholders (real values in gitignored docs/rig-addresses.local.md); guard tools/spicy_check.py untracked with the hook degrading to a no-op. main 5b267a8 -> 25a12ba, force-pushed, repo PUBLIC 9.1 MB. Verified across 6768 history blobs: 0 person names, 0 IPs, 0 secrets, 0 home paths, every .py compiles. Caveats: plate graphs + old actor-sweep probes now carry tokens, so replaying them as-is needs the local map and their trigger words no longer match (historical runs only); 5 benign HARD hits remain (2 false positives, 1 capability note, 2 honest memory-log lines left alone because memory/log is the truth ledger).
